title: Midnight Smoke Ritual
description: A young man with wild dark hair stands in a dimly lit room filled with swirling red and blue smoke, gesturing with one hand while standing at a wooden desk. The desk holds a glowing blue bong, lit candle, papers, and small objects while a hookah with red glowing base sits on the floor to the left and ghostly translucent figures emerge from a brightly lit open doorway in the background.
